definition_zh: 两年一次的；二年生的；两年一次的事件；二年生植物
definition_en: happening every two years, or lasting two years; a biennial plant or event
core_image: 两年才开一次的花，日历上隔年才翻到的那一页
scene: 隔一年才见一面的老友又寄来了请柬。The city hosts a biennial art exhibition.
sceneCN: 这里 biennial 是「两年一次的」（第 1 个义项：每两年发生一回）；句意是该市每两年举办一届艺术展。

pos.zh: 两年一度的事件；二年生植物

derivatives.zh: biennial 加 -ly，义为「每两年一次地」
同根拉丁名词，义为「两年期」
同族词，义为「每年的」，ann 为「年」
同族词，义为「三年一次的」
意大利语同源词，义为「双年展」

senses.title: Happening every two years
senses.example: The city hosts a biennial art exhibition.
senses.exampleCN: 该市每两年举办一届艺术展。
senses.why: Latin bi- means two and annus means year, so the word counts years by twos.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 bi- 指「二」，annus 指「年」，合起来即「隔两年」。

senses.title: Lasting two years
senses.definition: continuing for a period of two years
senses.example: The assembly approved a biennial budget.
senses.exampleCN: 议会批准了两年期预算。
senses.why: Not the rhythm of return but the length of span.
senses.whyCN: 不是往复的节奏，而是一段跨度。

senses.title: Of plants living two years
senses.definition: of a plant that takes two years to complete its life cycle
senses.definitionCN: 指用两个生长季完成生命周期的植物
senses.example: Carrots are biennial, flowering in their second year.
senses.exampleCN: 胡萝卜是二年生植物，第二年才开花。
senses.why: Botany borrowed the two-year count for plant lifespans.
senses.whyCN: 植物学借「两年」之数来记植物寿命。

senses.title: A biennial event
senses.definition: a large recurring event held every second year, especially in art
senses.definitionCN: 每两年举办一次的大型活动，多指艺术界
senses.example: The biennial drew curators from forty countries.
senses.exampleCN: 这届双年展吸引了四十个国家的策展人。
senses.why: The adjective hardens into the name of the event itself.
senses.whyCN: 形容词凝固为活动本身的名字。

senses.title: A biennial plant
senses.definition: a plant completing its cycle in two growing seasons
senses.definitionCN: 在两个生长季内完成周期的植物
senses.example: The nursery stocks hardy biennials for autumn sowing.
senses.exampleCN: 苗圃备有耐寒二年生植物供秋播。
senses.why: The botanical sense likewise becomes a noun.

senses.title: Recurring in alternate years (of sessions)
senses.definition: of meetings or sessions held in alternate years
senses.example: The society's biennial congress falls in odd years.
senses.exampleCN: 该学会的大会逢单数年召开。
senses.why: Institutional rhythm adopts the two-year beat.
senses.whyCN: 机构的节拍采纳了两年一拍。

senses.title: Of terms of office or reports
senses.definition: covering or valid for a two-year term
senses.example: Her biennial term on the board ends next spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她的两年董事会任期明年春天届满。
senses.why: The two-year span applies to tenure and documents.
senses.whyCN: 两年跨度同样适用于任期与文件。

senses.title: Contrasted with annual and perennial
senses.definition: in classification, standing between one-year and many-year cycles
senses.definitionCN: 在分类上介于一年生与多年生之间
senses.example: Gardeners sort seeds into annuals, biennials, and perennials.
senses.exampleCN: 园艺师把种子分为一年生、二年生与多年生。
senses.why: The word fills the middle rung of a time ladder.
senses.whyCN: 该词补上时间阶梯的中间一档。

intro.en: Biennial joins Latin bi-, two, and annus, year.
intro.cn: biennial 由拉丁语 bi-「二」加 annus「年」构成。

items.en: dwo- meant two; at- meant to go, source of year words; reconstructed forms.
items.cn: dwo- 意为「二」；at- 意为「行走」，为 year 词系的来源（重构形式）。

items.en: biennium meant a two-year period, from bi- plus annus.
items.cn: 拉丁语 biennium 意为「两年期」，由 bi- 加 annus 构成。
拉丁语 biennis 意为「持续两年的」。

items.en: English adopted biennial in the 16th century for two-year spans and rhythms.
items.cn: 英语于 16 世纪借入 biennial，指两年跨度与节律。

items.en: now covers events, budgets, plant lifecycles, and the art biennale.
items.cn: 如今涵盖活动、预算、植物生命周期及艺术双年展。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bi- and ann- roots; the near-meaning group gathers frequency words often confused with it.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bi- 与 ann- 词根；近义组汇集常被混淆的频率词。

entries.definitionCN: 一年两次的——与 biennial 极易混淆

entries.definition: a large international art exhibition held every two years
entries.definitionCN: （艺术）双年展——意大利语同源名词
每两年一次地——副词形式

normalIntro.en: Biennial is bi- (two) plus annus (year): two-yearly.
normalIntro.cn: biennial 是 bi-（二）加 annus（年）：两年一回。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with biannual, twice a year.
normal.cn: 不要与 biannual（一年两次）混淆。

normal.en: The art event is the biennale.
Carrots and onions are biennial plants.
normal.cn: 胡萝卜与洋葱是二年生植物。

normal.en: Triennial moves the beat to three years.

abstract.en: See a calendar page skipped once between visits.
abstract.cn: 看日历在两次相会间被跳过一页。

abstract.en: Feel the plant storing strength for a second spring.
abstract.cn: 感受植物为第二个春天蓄力。

abstract.en: Picture the exhibition poster reprinted every other year.
abstract.cn: 想象展览海报每隔一年重印一次。

examples.en: The city hosts a biennial art exhibition.
examples.cn: 该市每两年举办一届艺术展。

examples.en: Carrots are biennial, flowering in their second year.
examples.cn: 胡萝卜是二年生植物，第二年才开花。

examples.en: The assembly approved a biennial budget.
examples.cn: 议会批准了两年期预算。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摆恩尼奥」——每隔两年才摆一次恩情宴（双年一摆）。

root: 拉丁语 bi-「二」（上溯至原始印欧语 dwo-，重构形式）加 annus「年」（一般认为上溯至原始印欧语 at-「行走」，指季节之轮转）；拉丁 biennis「持续两年的」，16 世纪进入英语，现代兼指两年节律、两年跨度与二年生植物。

sensesIntro.en: A two-year count splits into rhythm, span, and the plant that lives by it.
sensesIntro.cn: 「两年」之数分化为节律、跨度，以及依此存活的植物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clock that ticks once every two years
core.cn: 核心意象：每两年才走一格的钟

branches.cn: 跨越两个生长季的植物

intro.en: Biennial is a Latin number-plus-noun compound turned adjective.
intro.cn: biennial 是「数词加名词」的拉丁复合词转成的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The annus family of time words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 annus 时间词族。
